transform_summary: Preserved source IDs and parent administration hierarchy.
One location dimension row per project grid point; not treated as parcel boundary.
Season-year dimension; canonical source boundaries preserved; study-only years have no invented start/end dates.
Retained publisher/source URLs and lineage.
One study dimension per publication; methods and limitations retained.
Aliases indexed for previous-crop matching; Rice mapped to the existing reference member.
One row per variety; catalog traits joined by declared variety ID; placeholder flagged.
Dated variety-guide snapshots retained separately from catalogue traits; source ranges are not collapsed.
Only ISO dates parsed into calendar keys; free-text windows remain unparsed.
Long-form weather fact; NULL values preserved and flagged; NASA/grid status retained.
Soil and AWC columns unpivoted to property rows; map/interpolated status preserved. Organic-carbon and bulk-density units flagged for review.
ET0/ETc retained as derived crop-water estimates; not relabelled as irrigation volume.
Separate water-model dimension and version-specific seasonal scenario fact; v3 is identifiable and legacy records are not pooled.
Regional crop area/production/yield kept at reported scale and source level.
Trial outcomes linked to study/year/variety/treatment/metric; source units retained with explicit standard unit where supported.
Published trial observations linked to study/year/metric; previous crop aliases matched where unambiguous.
Measurements separated by sample kind, treatment and study; original unit/status preserved.
Qualitative assertions retained as non-additive evidence; not mixed into numeric measures.
Textual windows are preserved verbatim; only exact date columns can become date keys.
Unified guidance fact keeps source type, scope, validity, confidence and review notes distinct.
Preserved as reference guidance; records lacking product/rate/PHI are flagged non-operational.
Catalog families retained; no matched flow/head pair inferred.
Method reference dimension.
Aggregate machinery inventory retained at published geographic level; not interpreted as farmer pump inventory.
Per-location season summary retained with weather coverage/readiness flags; estimates are labelled as estimates.
Baseline per-location scenarios kept separately from variety-specific model versions.
Water coefficients/assumptions retained with stage, range, source and validity conditions.
Installed pump dimension defined; current source has no rows.
Parcel dimension defined; no parcel records imported.
Scene metadata and shortlist flags retained; imagery indices not downloaded or calculated.
